verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no Langfuse policy, setting, or contractual commitment saying customer trace or prompt data is excluded from AI model training. The documented self-hosting option keeps data on your own infrastructure. That is a data-residency feature, not a training opt-out, so it is an adjacent control and earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
